description: REEF3D::SEASTATE surfbeat (A 770 1) coupled with the semi-implicit NHFLOW (A 510 11, hydrostatic, dt 0.1 s): the case of seastate_nhflow_surfbeat (wave groups on the GLOBEX profile, radiation stress with roller, 450 x 1 x 2 cells, 40 s). The absorbing-generating long-wave boundary at the x- side as a Flather face of the step: with the long-wave ghost velocity u_g = q_b/h - sqrt(g/h) (eta_1 - zeta_b) the column discharge is q_in = q_b + sqrt(g h) zeta_b - sqrt(g h) eta^{n+1}, implicit in eta^{n+1}. At the explicit time step the gauges are within 5 % of the explicit RK2 until the reflection from the shoreline returns (validation 10).
covers: nhflow_momentum_SI::bc_setup: surfbeat Flather faces at the x- side
